messages:
alice: Deploy finished at 12:02UTC to eu-ingress. Observed mTLS handshake error rate up ~2.3% starting 12:03UTC. Logs show `issuer CN=ephemeral-issuer-eu-2025` for a subset of clients, but I can't find issuance events in the compliance feed. Anyone flip the issuer?
ben: that was me — I rolled the ephemeral issuer to speed rotations earlier. I only changed `IssuerName` in cert-provisioner; I thought `auditbot` would pick it up. didn't touch Vault/AWS KMS roles.
clara: fyi we tightened RBAC on `vault-signing` yesterday ~22:40UTC in eu-prod (removed broad `auditing.write` on the rotator service principal). Could be the signer couldn't attach `audit.metadata` so the rotator fell back to a cached local issuer.
alice: the handshake errors are mixed: `tls: no client certificate` and `tls: certificate signed by unknown authority`. sample: ```[12:04:17] eu-ingress tls_handshake error: client=10.0.1.5 err=tls: certificate signed by unknown authority issuer=ephemeral-issuer-eu-2025 cert_id=abc123```
oncall-bot: incident created: #1734561234 — high mTLS handshake error rate in eu-ingress.
clara: can someone query Vault audit: `SELECT * FROM vault_audit WHERE path LIKE '%sign%issuer%' AND time >= '2025-03-12T11:30:00Z'` — suspect audit shipper filter dropped ephemeral issuances.
ben: looking at rotator config: `issuer: ephemeral-issuer-eu-2025`, `audit_hook: auditship-v1` — infra deprecated `auditship-v1` yesterday. I didn't update the hook.
alice: concrete mitigation: pause ephemeral issuer rollout in eu and rollback to `issuer=redwood-root-v2`. Re-enable a validated audit hook. Who owns rollback?
ben: I'll run the rollback (starting in ~2m). I'll also open a PR to update the audit hook target to `auditship-stable`. @clara can you verify RBAC?
clara: will restore `vault-signing` scope to include `auditing.write` for the rotator service account and run a smoke on auditship. posting the IAM diff in a sec.
auditbot: detected missing issuance audit entries for `ephemeral-issuer-eu-2025`. correlated requestIDs: `req=lh-abc123`, `req=lh-def456`. recommend backfilling issuance events from signer and tagging them `compliance:backfill=true`.
alice: action items: ben=rollback + PR; clara=RBAC restore + smoke test; alice=query sample set and export to S3 for compliance review. We reconvene in 15m if errors don't drop. :page_facing_up: 
ben: rollback started, will post progress and revert outcome here.
